old_problem: LAN is ambiguous on a server with host NICs plus shared or dedicated BMC ports. The source filter suggests a motherboard 1G LAN thermal sensor but does not bind a controller, port, role, physical location or complete population. Historical review also escalated the 1/2/26 numbering gap.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict through ED-03 parameterization: Project Configuration binds the motherboard 1G management controller, shared/dedicated port role, physical sensor location and complete TEMP_MB_1G_LAN population. Read-only five-view telemetry is sufficient for reporting validation; this row does not authorize link flaps, cable tests or configuration changes. ED-15 prevents invented ranges and the 1/2/26 gap remains an editorial defect.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2022, same-row DeepSeek data, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2023 / Wistron-BMC-01043-V002 / 308e14725b0f7018.
The literal TEMP_MB_1G_LAN filter narrows the intended domain but cannot by itself identify the hardware, management-port role or number of sensors.
Complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists plus all Web rows establish population and interface parity after an approved controller/port/location crosswalk is supplied.
Passive link speed/state and workload context explain temperature conditions without exercising Ethernet traffic, failover, channel changes or cable actions.
Criteria 1, 2 and 26 are preserved verbatim; no absent checks 3-25 are created.
No ipmitool, authentication, LAN/sensor read, Web capture, network reconfiguration, link flap, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Motherboard 1G management-LAN sensor reporting and physical-port reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify the complete sensor set for the intended motherboard 1G management-LAN controller/port reports the correct identity, location, value, units, state, thresholds and freshness across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
required_package: SUT/BMC/motherboard revision and exact 1G management-LAN controller, port and shared-or-dedicated role
Complete TEMP_MB_1G_LAN population with physical sensor location and five-view crosswalk
Versioned sensor range/state/threshold/freshness rules plus normal passive link speed/state, workload and environment context
Approved ipmitool and protected IB/OOB/Web credentials with evidence retention
Network/BMC owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; bind the exact motherboard 1G management controller/port/role and sensor location. Preserve logs. Capture complete untruncated aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs before filtering TEMP_MB_1G_LAN, capture every relevant BMC Web row/page, and record passive link speed/state plus workload/thermal context. Compare population and all fields with the approved map and SPEC. Do not treat the title as a sensor, truncate evidence, reconfigure channels, flap links, disconnect cables, write thresholds, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved motherboard 1G management-LAN sensor appears exactly once at the correct controller/port/location with SPEC-valid, fresh and mutually consistent fields across all five views; passive link and thermal context show no unexpected fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact controller/port/role binding, complete population/map and full IB/OOB/Web evidence meeting approved limits. FAIL on wrong controller/port, missing/extra/duplicate/stale sensor, field mismatch, exceeded approved limit, link loss not explained by the recipe or thermal alarm. Missing map or limits is NOT READY; the end user decides the verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no LAN/channel/configuration changes, link flaps, cable handling, threshold writes or thermal stimulus.
Protect credentials and preserve full raw lists before filtering.
Stop on ambiguous port identity, unexpected link loss, missing/duplicate/stale records, mismatch or thermal alarm.
No automatic retry and no log clearing; preserve first discrepancy and network/thermal context.
expected_evidence: Exact source identity and SUT/BMC/motherboard inventory
Controller/port/role/location diagram and complete TEMP_MB_1G_LAN five-view map
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web screenshots/export with pagination
Per-member comparison plus passive link speed/state, traffic/workload and thermal context
Criteria numbering, no-write/no-flap/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If target or port mapping is wrong, access fails, a sensor is absent/stale/mismatched, link state changes or a thermal alarm occurs, stop collection and preserve the first state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not modify BMC channels, flap links, clear logs or retry; escalate the exact controller/port and sensor ID to network/BMC owners.

source_conflict.reason: A required controller/port/role/location crosswalk disambiguates LAN and proves TEMP_MB_1G_LAN completeness; numbering 1/2/26 is preserved as editorial only.

blocked.reason: The passive operation, evidence, safety and recovery are complete; hardware mapping and limits are runtime Project Configuration.

pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO PORT-BOUND PASSIVE SENSOR RECONCILIATION; NO IPMITOOL, AUTHENTICATION, LAN/SENSOR READ, WEB CAPTURE, LINK/CHANNEL/CABLE ACTION, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
